initialization: restore only the original untrained LitePT backbone and buffers; seed 23 for new modules; do not load the binary head

model.backbone: LitePT-S; 9 joint voxel channels; all parameters trainable
model.head_checkpointing: recompute deterministic point head during backward; backbone executes once

supervision.normal_groups: existing groups 0..18; binary-normal target with semantic target 255 maps to other_normal=19
supervision.inactive_groups: exclude groups with zero frozen 206 supervision from support and normalization
supervision.scope: all valid points across the five frames; no official range or minimum anomaly point filter
supervision.detection: normal window class mean/(2*pi_normal) + anomaly window class mean/(2*pi_anomaly); absent class contributes zero
supervision.semantic: weighted mean cross entropy over active normal groups, divided by log(K)
supervision.normal_tail: mean softplus(score) over ceil(1% of valid normal points), at least one if present
supervision.tail_warmup: coefficient from 0 at successful update 1 to 0.1 at update 1000

training.learning_rate: 200 successful updates linearly from 3e-5 to 3e-4; then 3e-4 through visit 14240, 1e-4 through 21360, 3e-5 through 28480
training.optimizer: AdamW; betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8; decay 0.01 except raw prototypes, acceptance, normalization and biases
training.precision: existing float16 autocast; cosine support, logits, logsumexp and loss use float32
training.sampling: uniform shuffled full passes without replacement; no extra augmentation or resampling
training.overflow: record without replacement; stop after three consecutive overflows

selection: maximum fixed real monitor AP; within 0.1 percentage point use lower FPR95, lower normal fraction at logit >=0, then earlier visit

evaluation.storage: all actual input points, lossless float32 with original identities
evaluation.real: all 8659 original frames; unchanged startup, slot restoration and official filtering
evaluation.semantic: normal 201 current points only; never treat real val normal labels as fine semantic truth
evaluation.baseline: reuse retained epoch_07 real results; data and model both changed, so no single-module causal claim

interpretation: one development model on fixed v2 observations; no preliminary A/B/C training or coefficient search
